typecheck.command: bun run check-types && bun x tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p apps/storybook/tsconfig.json

appliedUpdates.description: Added Convex anyApi Proxy re-render pitfall documentation to .factory/library/architecture.md — explains that api.X.Y creates a new FunctionReference on every access (Proxy), causing infinite re-renders when used inside component render bodies. Fix: hoist to module scope.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: Sentry is now integrated into apps/web (@sentry/nextjs). Workers modifying the web app should be aware of the Sentry instrumentation layer (sentry.*.config.ts, instrumentation.ts, global-error.tsx) and the Convex log-stream webhook route (api/convex/log-stream). New web features should follow the existing Sentry tracing patterns.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature web-migrate-to-shared-ui-and-clean-boundaries added a full Sentry integration (6 config/instrumentation files, @sentry/nextjs dependency, convex-observability wrapper, and a 215-line Convex log-stream webhook route) as out-of-scope additions. These are now part of the codebase and future workers need to know about them.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: Sentry configuration values (org, project, sentryUrl) in apps/web/next.config.ts are currently hardcoded. Consider migrating to environment variables if these values differ across environments.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: apps/web/next.config.ts lines 10-12 contain hardcoded strings: org 'ansl-ai', project 'next', sentryUrl 'https://watcher.ecorp.cc/'.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The shared-ui-worker skill could mention the Convex anyApi Proxy re-render pitfall as a known gotcha when working with Convex queries in React components, since this mission involves Convex-backed web apps.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Worker's skill feedback suggested this addition. The bug was a real blocker (Too many re-renders) that required understanding Convex's Proxy-based API pattern.
